mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant (name, type, contact_person, contact_phone, introduction, logo_file_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{introduction}, #{logoFileId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant SET name=#{name}, type=#{type}, contact_person=#{contactPerson}, contact_phone=#{contactPhone}, introduction=#{introduction}, logo_file_id=#{logoFileId}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, contact_person, contact_phone, introduction, logo_file_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM merchant WHERE id=#{id}
